DEBUG_FULLSCREEN.title: Debug Mode (Fullscreen)
DEBUG_FULLSCREEN.description: Launches in fullscreen with debugging (-debug), captures live logs and detects crashes.

DEBUG_WINDOWED.title: Debug Mode (Windowed)
DEBUG_WINDOWED.description: Same live debugging (-debug), but in windowed mode to view the app and game in parallel.

NORMAL_FULLSCREEN.title: Normal Game (Fullscreen)
NORMAL_FULLSCREEN.description: Standard native game in full screen (without -debug flag) for regular gameplay.

NORMAL_WINDOWED.title: Normal Game (Windowed)
NORMAL_WINDOWED.description: Standard native game in windowed mode (without -debug flag) for regular gameplay.

language.title: Language
language.blurb: The language the Studio speaks. English is the source; a language that misses a line shows it in English. The game's own messages (errors, warnings, the Monitor's log lines) stay as the game writes them.
language.contribute: Another language is one file: src/locales/<code>.json in the Studio's repository, proposed like anything else there.

No mods found yet, so a profile saved now would switch all your mods off.

Set your game and Zomboid folders in App Settings first; the Studio will find your mods, and then a profile will remember them.

Create an empty profile?

Switching to it turns every mod off, which is what you want before subscribing to a new set. Your other profiles keep their mods.

row.draftLocked: This package is open in draft mode and deactivated. It cannot be enabled until it is packaged/published in Mod Merger.
row.bridgeTitle: PZ Mod Studio Live Bridge Companion Mod
row.openDraftTitle:
Open Package (Draft): {{id}}
This package is in editing mode and deactivated. Package / publish it in Mod Merger to use it in-game.
row.packagedTitle:
Packaged Mod (Closed): {{id}}
Contains compiled compatibility patches ready for Project Zomboid.
row.notForBuildTitle: This mod has no mod.info the installed game build reads (B41-only, or only folders for newer builds). The game will not load it.
row.loadTimeTitle:
Loading time: of the time the game spent on the loading screen last session, {{time}} went to reading this mod's files.

Most mods take a few milliseconds; tile and model packs take seconds. It says nothing about how the mod runs once loaded.

Measured from the game's own DebugLog (Zomboid/Logs), from this mod's "loading" line to the next mod's; the Lua phase after that is one pass and is not timed per mod.
row.errorsTitle: Last session the game logged {{count}} error(s) from this mod: something in its code threw, and whatever it was doing at that moment did not finish.
row.warningsTitle: Last session the game logged {{count}} warning(s) about this mod: the game noticed something odd and carried on, so nothing broke by itself.
row.requireNote: (require(...) failed: the mod asked for a file the game could not find at that path. Harmless unless a feature is missing; the Monitor Center can fix the path.)
row.fromConsole: From console.txt as it is now; the Monitor Center has the full cards.
